title: Formation of working groups to come out with comprehensive framework for cyber security in insurance sector
full_text:
**INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** The CEOs of all insurers IRDAI is planning to come out with a comprehensive cyber security framework for Insurance sector of India in the wake of recent cyber-attacks and also implement appropriate mechanism to mitigate cyber risks. In this connection, it has been decided to form two separate working groups for life and non-life sector (including health) comprising of CIOs of insurers to discuss and decide on the issues related cyber security. a) Suggest recommendations with respect to **Cyber security** in order to comprehensively provide for a broad framework to mitigate present internal end of Jan'2017,
